<ic>To modify the position of Advisor on Orc Affairs to change the term to one year.<br><br>Proposed by Redoubt, Seconded by Conscience</ic>

===Overview===
* The [[Advisor on Orc Affairs]] will now have an annual term, rather than a life-time tenure.

===Date===
* Spring 379YE

===Campaign Outcome===
* The tenure of the Advisor was amended.
